mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing betamethasone metabolism inhibition and corticosteroid exposure; betamethasone may increase clarithromycin levels and risk of adverse effects.
action: Monitor for enhanced corticosteroid effects (hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, hypertension) and clarithromycin toxicity; consider dose adjustment or alternative antibiotic if prolonged use anticipated.
